description: The plot illustrates the performance of different model variants on the HateXplain dataset, comparing their precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis represents the model variants, labeled as "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", with no numerical scale or units. The y-axis is labeled as "Metric (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays three lines: precision (purple, solid line, circle markers), recall (blue, solid line, circle markers), and F1-score (brown, solid line, circle markers). The precision line starts at 65.49 for the full model and ends at 65.44 for the "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant, with values decreasing to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt", then increasing to 62.63 for "w/o Augmentation", followed by an increase to 64.06 for "w/o Attention". The recall line begins at 65.78 for the full model, decreases to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", increases to 62.22 for "w/o Augmentation", then declines to 59.17 for "w/o Attention" and further to 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The F1-score line starts at 65.55 for the full model, drops to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.7 for "w/o Augmentation", then decreases to 59.67 for "w/o Attention" and ends at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
